label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: The first efficient cause is what everyone names God
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., secunda via: quam omnes Deum nominant
interpretation: A nominal identification kept separate from the conclusion, as for the prima via (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-UNDERSTOOD-AS-GOD-A) and the quarta via (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-QUARTA-VIA-DICIMUS-DEUM-A). It reports how the name is used and is not used by any result.
